name: Glenn Thompson

accounts.evidence: The official campaign website of Congressman Glenn 'GT' Thompson (paid for by Friends of Glenn Thompson) links to x.com/gt_teamgt.

notes: Politwoops lists the same account as GT_TeamGT (capitalization differs); handle recorded as written on the campaign site.

name: Mike Kelly
notes: No campaign website found by the one allowed search. LegiStorm lists only official links (x.com/MikeKellyPA, already on file); it says campaign links exist but are hidden behind a paid subscription. No campaign X handle confirmed.

accounts.evidence: Chris Deluzio's campaign website chrisforpa.com links to twitter.com/ChrisForPA.

name: Gabe Amo

accounts.evidence: Gabe Amo's campaign website gabeamo.com links to twitter.com/gabeamo alongside its gabeamoforcongress Facebook, Instagram and YouTube accounts.

notes: The campaign page may date from the 2023 special election; the account may be used as a personal account. Labeled campaign because the campaign site links it.

name: Seth Magaziner

accounts.evidence: Seth Magaziner's campaign website sethmagaziner.com ('Join Team Seth') links to twitter.com/SethMagaziner.

notes: This handle predates his time in Congress (used as Rhode Island treasurer); it serves as his personal/campaign account.

name: Nancy Mace

accounts.evidence: A Christian Post news article on her 2025 governor campaign launch embeds her post attributed to 'Nancy Mace (@NancyMace)'.

notes: The article names nancymace.org as her (governor) campaign website; I did not open it to check its X link. She ran for South Carolina governor in 2026, not for re-election to the House.

Sheri Biggs's campaign website sheribiggs.com links to twitter.com/VoteSheriBiggs.

name: Ralph Norman
notes: Unconfirmed lead: search summary said a Townhall article embeds posts from 'Ralph Norman for Governor (@RalphNorman)', and Politwoops tracks a RalphNorman account, but the Townhall page returned 404 and the SC Daily Gazette and Daily Signal pages returned 403, so no opened page confirmed the handle.
